reason: ₹22,000, or ₹28,500 with the panel, is about a month and a half to two months of what I earn, and the women at home already manage the washing by hand. If I ever spend that kind of money it would go on a bigger battery or inverter for the solar system that runs lights and fans too, not on something that only washes clothes.
objection: I don't believe a machine is needed when hand-washing costs nothing, and ₹1,999 a month for a year is a real burden; I'd also have to keep a water supply going for it, and my solar setup is small, so I'm not sure the panel and charging would really work for us.
would_change_my_mind: A price near ₹10,000 with a small EMI, and a dealer demo in our village showing it run on our own solar power with the water we have.
